notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware or upstream pybullet/EGL run was made. The fake (fake.py) is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for calvin_env.envs.play_table_env:PlayTableSimEnv: it applies the four upstream action dict types and the relative scales of Robot.relative_to_absolute, advances a tcp pose and a small scene state, and returns the upstream four-value step tuple (reward 0, done False). It has no contacts, IK, motors, sensors or pybullet and was never compared with an upstream run; the fidelity gaps say so. Upstream needs pybullet, EGL, hydra and a CALVIN dataset directory, which were not installed or run. NOT COVERED: the full-resolution rgb and depth camera arrays. The configured cameras are static 200x200, gripper 84x84 and tactile 120x160 (conf/cameras/cameras/static.yaml:7-8, gripper.yaml:7-8, tactile.yaml:3-4); the fake returns 4x4 RGB and 4x4 depth placeholders, as the fidelity gaps state. The upstream environment defines no action_space/observation_space. The step action is the open object of cap.world.step.v1, passed unchanged, so no action bound exists to declare; reset advertises only the seed the legacy seed() supports (the bridge does not forward reset options or the initial robot/scene observations). The catalogue classes cap.world.* cover the device, so no extension ids and no catalogue requests. Because no actuating capability declares a limit, the in-process MHS-Sim suite awards CL2 (G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: SAFE-014 has nothing to probe); every other CL3 test passed. Expected Gymnasium-family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset) and G8.NO_UNIT for seed twice and ticks. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings: every fact cites a text line of the clone. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
